name: George Alexander Foundation Scholarship (RMIT)
summary: Up to $10,000 a year for high-achieving rural and regional students moving to Melbourne to start a bachelor degree at RMIT.
key: Up to $10,000 a year for up to three years. Seven offered.
who: From a rural, regional or remote area and moving to Melbourne for the first time.
ATAR of 80 or higher, plus community involvement and leadership.
how: Complete the online application with supporting documents by the close date.

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides up to $10,000 per year for up to three years.
Applications for Semester 1 2027 close 11:59pm Sunday 31 January 2027.
